question: Across independent historical conflicts, does recent nonlocal insurgent activity carry reproducible predictive information for new/recurrent activity in administratively observed units after a one-year quiet period, beyond simple distance to the nearest recently active unit?
interpretation_boundary: This tests an observable implication of nonlocal reproduction. It does not identify rooted membership M_star, prove recruitment caused the event, or estimate a historical recruitment-hazard coefficient.

colombia_1984_2016.principal_actor_rule: actor field contains FARC as an exact comma-delimited actor token

iraq_2003_2011.interpretation: UCDP IS/AQI-lineage activity as coded in GED 26.1

vietnam_1955_1975.interpretation: MACV/NARA cleaned opposing-force initiated activity; actor resolution is aggregate and therefore lower-specificity than UCDP cases

risk_set.quiet_definition: zero principal-actor events in the focal unit during all 12 preceding source-covered calendar months
risk_set.coverage_rule: anchor, all quiet-period months, and all outcome-window months must be explicitly source-covered; source_gap months are excluded, never treated as zero
risk_set.focal_unit_rule: use each standardized bundle's canonical geography unit
risk_set.event_rule: all retained mapped events involving the principal actor; violence type is not used to select favorable outcomes

predictors_available_at_anchor.nearest_active_distance_km: great-circle centroid distance to the nearest OTHER unit with >=1 principal-actor event in the preceding 3 months
predictors_available_at_anchor.case_length_scale_L: median nearest-neighbor centroid distance among all canonical geography units in the case; geography-only and outcome-independent
predictors_available_at_anchor.dynamic_nonlocal_pressure_H: sum over OTHER units j of log(1 + principal_actor_events_j,past3) * exp(-distance_ij / L)
predictors_available_at_anchor.zero_source_rule: if no other unit was active in the preceding 3 months, H=0 and nearest distance is set to case maximum pair distance + L

outcomes.primary: any principal-actor event in focal unit during months t+1..t+3 (approximately 90 days)
outcomes.secondary_30d: any principal-actor event in month t+1
outcomes.secondary_365d: any principal-actor event in months t+1..t+12

secondary_metrics: positive-onset distance distribution relative to L
fraction of positive onsets whose nearest recent source is farther than 2L

guards: A pass does not validate Pineland coefficients or latent historical recruitment hazard.
A failure is permanent evidence against transport of this observable implication at the chosen administrative/time scales.
Nigeria 2014 is excluded and remains sealed.
No synthetic parameter or historical database row is changed as a result of this test.
